allow: Bash(node -e "const {DatabaseSync}=require\('node:sqlite'\); const db=new DatabaseSync\('data/list.db'\); console.log\('levels w/ gd_id:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM levels WHERE gd_id IS NOT NULL'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('void w/ gd_id:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM void_levels WHERE gd_id IS NOT NULL'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('awaiting w/ gd_id:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM awaiting_levels WHERE gd_id IS NOT NULL'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('cache rows:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM gd_info_cache'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('missing main:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM levels l WHERE l.gd_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS \(SELECT 1 FROM gd_info_cache c WHERE c.gd_id=l.gd_id\)'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('missing void:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM void_levels l WHERE l.gd_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS \(SELECT 1 FROM gd_info_cache c WHERE c.gd_id=l.gd_id\)'\).get\(\)\); console.log\('missing awaiting:', db.prepare\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM awaiting_levels l WHERE l.gd_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS \(SELECT 1 FROM gd_info_cache c WHERE c.gd_id=l.gd_id\)'\).get\(\)\);")
